security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick findings are documentation false positives, but the setup does require cloning and executing third-party Node code. Confirmed risks are tied to git clone, npm install, npm run start-server, command substitution, and dashboard startup. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the cloned repository to a reviewed commit or release, and document how users can verify the source before running it.

remediation.issue: NPM install and server commands run in the user workspace
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before command execution, recommend a sandboxed directory, and avoid automatic setup without explicit consent.

remediation.issue: MCP server and dashboard access project memory data
remediation.suggestion: Document workspace scope, sensitive data handling, and any dashboard access controls before publication.

content.value_statement: AI agents often lose project context between sessions. This skill provides a searchable MCP memory layer for decisions, patterns, and architecture notes.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup of an Agent Memory MCP server for project-specific memory.
Documents memory_search for finding memories by query, type, or tags.
Documents memory_write for storing decisions, patterns, and project notes.
Documents memory_read for retrieving specific memory records by key.
Documents memory_stats and dashboard access for usage visibility.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and manual repository setup.
Depends on a third-party repository that is not bundled with the skill.
Requires users to run local npm commands and an MCP server.
Does not define authentication or access controls for the dashboard.

use_cases.title: Preserve Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Store decisions, tradeoffs, and patterns so agents can reuse project knowledge in later sessions.

use_cases.title: Search Project Context
use_cases.description: Find prior notes about authentication, deployment, or coding patterns before changing related files.

use_cases.title: Review Memory Coverage
use_cases.description: Use memory statistics and the dashboard to see which project areas need better documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Find Project Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-memory-mcp to search for prior decisions about [topic]. Summarize the most relevant memories and cite their keys.

prompt_templates.title: Save a Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Record the decision about [decision]. Include the reason, alternatives considered, and tags for future search.

prompt_templates.title: Plan With Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Search memories related to [feature]. Use the results to propose an implementation plan that follows known project patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Memory Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Review memory statistics for [project area]. Identify stale, missing, or duplicated memories and recommend cleanup actions.

output_examples.output: The skill returns matching memory titles, concise summaries, tags, and keys for the most relevant authentication records.

output_examples.input: Save the new deployment rollback decision.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms the memory was saved under the requested key and includes the assigned type and tags.

output_examples.input: Show memory statistics for this workspace.
output_examples.output: The skill reports counts by memory type and highlights areas with sparse stored knowledge.

best_practices: Pin the external repository to a trusted commit before setup.
Use clear keys and tags so future searches return precise results.
Review stored memories for sensitive data before sharing a workspace.
anti_patterns: Do not store secrets, tokens, or private customer data as memories.
Do not run the MCP server against unrelated workspaces.
Do not expose the dashboard beyond localhost without access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill add?
faq.answer: It adds an MCP-based memory workflow for storing, reading, searching, and reviewing project knowledge.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require installation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs users to clone a repository, install dependencies, compile, and start a server.

faq.question: Can it search by tags?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented memory_search tool accepts query text, type, and optional tags.

faq.question: Is the dashboard included?
faq.answer: The skill documents a local dashboard that starts with an npm command and opens on localhost.

faq.question: Should I store secrets in memory?
faq.answer: No. Avoid storing credentials, tokens, private customer data, or other sensitive information.
